stations.title: The API
stations.text: Signs her in, then forgets her at once.

stations.title: Ivo's page
stations.note: Its scripts never see the token.

captions: Ivo's page signs Sunniva in, and he wants the API to remember her on the next request.
Today each request stands alone, so the next one comes from a stranger.
You make a secure token, send it in a cookie, and read it back on every request.
Now the next request carries the cookie, and the API knows it is Sunniva.
The browser carries the token, the server keeps the session, and scripts never see it.
